page_title: Rajendra Prasad N - Azure DevOps Engineer | Web3 Platform
headline: Senior DevOps Engineer | Azure Cloud, Web3 Platform, DevSecOps & IaC
summary_html: Senior DevOps Engineer with 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise platform infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and DevSecOps practices across Azure and multi-cloud environments. Deep hands-on expertise with Azure VMs, VNet, Azure AD, Key Vault, Storage, Functions, Terraform, Bicep, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Python, Bash, and PowerShell, with applied experience supporting distributed Web3 and DLT platform workloads — including Besu- and Canton-aligned node infrastructure, private chain environments, and secure deployment patterns. Proven track record designing reusable IaC modules, hardening CI/CD pipelines with SAST/DAST and CNAPP controls, building observability stacks, and coordinating globally distributed engineering teams to ship stable, secure, and scalable platform releases in regulated enterprise settings.

achievements.text: Designed and maintained Azure-native infrastructure using Terraform and Bicep across VNet, Azure AD, Key Vault, VMs, Storage, and Functions to support scalable, multi-environment enterprise platform delivery.

Supported Besu- and Canton-aligned DLT node infrastructure on Azure DLT, delivering secure deployment patterns, private networking, and repeatable provisioning for blockchain platform workloads in regulated environments.

Embedded DevSecOps controls — SAST, DAST, secrets scanning, image validation, CNAPP policy enforcement, and gated approval gates — into CI/CD pipelines to strengthen supply-chain security and platform compliance.

Built and modernized CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and GitLab CI with secure runner standards, branch protections, Terraform validation, and artifact scanning to automate delivery across controlled environments.

Implemented Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, and Splunk-based observability stacks with alerting and runbooks to accelerate incident identification and drive SRE-grade platform reliability for global engineering teams.
